title: Kissed Adventurous Uruguayan Mulukhiyah Stir Fry
description: A funky and adventurous Uruguayan dish featuring mulukhiyah, this stir fry is macrobiotic friendly and cooked to perfection in a tandoor clay pot, with a delightful cheese pull.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor clay pot in the oven at 400 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped onion, minced garlic, and mulukhiyah leaves.
Add the olive oil, tandoor clay pot seasoning, salt, black pepper, and chili flakes to the bowl and mix well.
Remove the preheated tandoor clay pot from the oven and carefully add the mixture from the bowl.
Top the mixture with the shredded uruguayan cheese.
Return the tandoor clay pot to the oven and bake for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the tandoor clay pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Kissed Adventurous Uruguayan Mulukhiyah Stir Fry hot, garnished with additional mulukhiyah leaves if desired.
